description.value: WorldMark Cascade Lodge is a Club Wyndham timeshare resort in Whistler's Northlands neighbourhood offering full suite-style accommodations, each with a fireplace and private deck suited to multi-night stays. The property positions itself as a four-season outdoor-adventure base in one of BC's premier mountain destinations. Stays are available to both timeshare owners and non-owners through Club Wyndham's non-owner travel deals program.
